# Reolink Provider

Configures connections to one or more standalone Reolink cameras.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11.0"

  required_providers {
    reolink = {
      source  = "pragmatic-scm/community-reolink"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "reolink_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "reolink" {
  cameras = {
    front = {
      url      = "https://camera.example.com"
      username = "admin"
      password = var.reolink_password
      insecure = false
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cameras` (Attributes Map) Map of stable camera keys to Reolink management connections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cameras))

<a id="nestedatt--cameras"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cameras`

Required:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Camera administrator password.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the camera HTTP API.
- `username` (String) Camera administrator username.

Optional:

- `insecure` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate verification. Use only for cameras whose certificates cannot be verified.
